proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to register and publish; Epic Games takes a 12% revenue share, leaving 88% to the creator.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: A massive unified marketplace launched by Epic Games (merging Sketchfab, Quixel, and Unreal Engine Marketplace). It opens up a massive audience of game developers looking for 2D/3D assets, UI packs, and audio.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Pipeline: produce_gamedev_asset_pack. Export generated sprites, textures, and UI elements directly as packs to be listed on Fab alongside itch.io.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: High quality standards; assets must be properly packaged and categorized to pass validation.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: $1.80 free sign-up credit. FLUX-schnell costs $0.0015 per image, meaning ~1,200 high-quality images completely free before paying anything.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Incredible API response times, fully compatible with OpenAI-like API payloads, and hosts FLUX-schnell, FLUX-dev, and SDXL with no rate blocks on GitHub Actions IPs.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Pipeline: produce_coloring_book & produce_kdp_cover. Replaces the current failing image APIs inside GitHub Actions workflows.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires a credit card to reload after the free $1.80 is exhausted (though prices remain dirt cheap).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Generous daily free credits on signup; API access allows running complex multi-step generative workflows for free.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Allows you to build or use pre-made 'glifs' (workflows combining LLMs, image generators, ComfyUI, and vectorizers) and call them with a single API request.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Pipeline: produce_svg_pack or produce_coloring_book. Can run a specialized 'vectorizer' or 'line-art' glif to get clean SVGs directly.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: API structure is custom and requires learning their specific JSON payload format.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to publish; they take a 10% cut of the retail price only when a sale occurs.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Distributes paperbacks and ebooks to multiple major storefronts simultaneously (Barnes & Noble, Kobo, Apple Books, Tolino, Vivlio) with automated formatting tools.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Pipeline: produce_lowcontent_kdp. Expands distribution of low-content books beyond Amazon KDP to capture global markets.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Formatting templates are somewhat rigid compared to custom-designed KDP PDFs.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free, no API key required. Rate limits are dictated by Google Trends' standard web limits.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Allows programmatic extraction of trending search terms, interest over time, and related queries directly inside Python scripts.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Pipeline: agent_trendhunter or agent_niche_gap. Run weekly via GitHub Actions to identify rising search trends for POD designs.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: GitHub Actions runner IPs can sometimes trigger Google rate limits (HTTP 429); requires handling retries and backoffs.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to upload; 10% platform fee on direct sales or club memberships.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Prusa's official repository. It has high active engagement and allows creators to sell 3D printable files directly or set up subscription-based Clubs.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Pipeline: produce_stl_parametric. Publish parametric 3D models or STL packs to capture an audience distinct from Cults3D.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Community is highly technical; models must be highly functional and printable without errors.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to register and upload. Earn royalties per download (typically €0.05 to €0.10 per download, scaling with high volume).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Freepik has massive organic traffic and officially accepts high-quality AI-generated images, patterns, and vector files.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Pipeline: produce_svg_pack or produce_tumbler_wraps. Upload packs of patterns, backgrounds, and SVGs to earn passive download commissions.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Strict curation team; metadata, tags, and image quality must be pristine to be accepted.
